subscription.pastDue: We could not charge the renewal. Your plan is still active; we will try again on {{date}}. Change the card to pay now.
subscription.cancelling: Your subscription ends on {{date}}. Until then you keep everything you pay for.
subscription.owed: For this period's changes, {{amount}} + IGV goes on your next invoice on {{date}}.
subscription.cancelBody: It will not renew. You keep your plan until {{date}} and then move to the free plan, losing nothing you have running. You can undo this before that date.
subscription.cancelStages: If you do not pay again, the projects you do not keep will keep running on your servers, but without the platform: no deploys and no off-site backups. Off-site backups can be downloaded for 90 days. You can come back whenever you want.
subscription.pastDueGateway: Paddle could not charge the renewal. Your plan stays active while Paddle retries; update the card under "Invoices and card".

change.title: Change plan
change.lower: The change applies on {{date}}, when the paid period ends. Until then you keep your current plan.
change.period: Paying {{period}} starts on {{date}}, when the current period ends.
change.keep: You keep the plan and period you have, and any pending change is dropped.
change.owedNext: {{amount}} + IGV goes on your next invoice.
change.raise: You get the new plan now and the difference for what is left of the period is charged today: about {{amount}} + IGV.
change.toYear: Paying yearly starts today. The year is charged now, less the unused part of this month: about {{amount}} + IGV, with anything the month still owes.
change.throughGateway: The change applies from now. Paddle prorates it: it charges the difference today if the plan goes up, or leaves a credit for the next payments if it goes down. Add-ons move to the new period.
change.sentToGateway: Change sent. It shows here as soon as Paddle confirms it, usually within seconds.
